items.prompt:
An adaptation is
A) a heritable trait that helps survival in an environment
B) a type of weather
C) a kind of rock
D) a random event
items.answer: A) a heritable trait that helps survival in an environment

steps: An adaptation helps an organism survive.

items.prompt:
What process leads to adaptation?
A) Natural selection
B) Evaporation
C) Erosion
D) Freezing

In a cold climate, animals with ____ fur survive better.
A) thicker
B) thinner
C) no
D) wet

steps: Thick fur helps survive the cold.

items.prompt:
Over generations, a helpful trait in a population
A) becomes more common
B) disappears
C) stays rare
D) becomes harmful

steps: Helpful traits spread, adapting the population.

items.prompt:
A trait must be ____ to become an adaptation.
A) heritable
B) invisible
C) learned only
D) temporary

steps: Only heritable traits can spread and adapt a population.

items.prompt:
When only hard seeds are available, a bird population may adapt with
A) stronger beaks
B) weaker beaks
C) no beaks
D) longer legs only

steps: Strong beaks help eat hard seeds, so they spread.

items.prompt:
How does natural selection lead to adaptation?
A) Helpful traits are passed on and accumulate over generations until the population is adapted
B) Animals choose their traits
C) Traits appear instantly
D) Adaptation needs no traits
items.answer: A) Helpful traits are passed on and accumulate over generations until the population is adapted

steps: Accumulated selected traits adapt the population.

items.prompt:
A desert plant population becomes good at storing water because
A) water-storing plants survive and reproduce more, so the trait spreads
B) the plants decide to store water
C) water storage is not heritable
D) the desert gets wetter
items.answer: A) water-storing plants survive and reproduce more, so the trait spreads
